Scope Summary The Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County (Metro) is looking to enter into an indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity (IDIQ) contract with a contractor to provide fire and rescue supplies. Scope Detail Metro is seeking proposals from contractors to provide the Nashville Fire Department (NFD) with fire/rescue supplies and equipment. The scope of services shall include the following: e As the Fire Suppression industry is dynamic Vendors are required to provide all Fire Service items and services including but not limited to those documented. e Items must meet NFPA standards when required. supplies and equipment shall be new and not used. e The repair and maintenance of fire related equipment is requested but not required. Should the bidder include this in their response they shall are required to document a minimum of 5 years’ experience in providing fire service equipment and related repairs and the vendor repair personnel shall be required to maintain appropriate certification(s) as required by NFPA, OSHA, and state and federal standards and regulations. e Price quotes for all supplies and equipment will be provided as requested. e The contractor shall provide to Metro price quotes for all supplies as requested within twenty- four (24) hours or less of the request. In the event that Metro requests pricing on a Friday, quotes shall be provided Monday morning. e Items requested may be brand specific. ¢ Quotes requested for brand specific items may not be substituted without prior approval by the Department. o Inthe event brand substitutions are requested and approved all vendors will be informed of the substitution and be allowed to resubmit quotes accordingly. ¢ Quote request may be for single or multiple items and quantities. e Purchases will be awarded to the lowest aggregate quote. e Contractors are required to supply items current with market standards. e The contractor shall ensure that all items provided under this contract have documented expiration dates or shelf lives that are greater than twelve (12) months of the receiving date.
